This [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual<ref name="Mindor" /> was the '''[[Parent/Legends|mother]]''' of [[Cronal]].<ref name="Imperial" /> She had borne Cronal,<ref name="Mindor" /> and shortly after Cronal's [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]],<ref name="Imperial" /> Cronal was taken from her.<ref name="Mindor" /> Cronal suspected her to have been a [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Imperial" />
